}}'''Zang''' is a soldier of the [[Tower Guard]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zang}}

== Activities ==
Since returning to the [[White Tower]], Zang is one of a number of [[Younglings]] who decide that being a [[Warder]] is not the life for them. [[Gawyn Trakand]] tells them to report to [[Jimar Chubain]] to become a member of the Tower Guard.

== Trivia ==
* Zang is named for Han Zhang, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
